title: Dual wielding
wikitext:
[[File:Dual wielding screenshot.png|thumb|right|200px|A [[marauder]] dual wielding two {{il|Hand of Wisdom and Action}}]]
'''Dual wielding''' refers to using a [[one-handed]] [[weapon]] in both hands.  

==Mechanics==
Dual wielding grants player characters these inherent bonuses:
{{#cargo_query:
|tables = generic_stats
|fields = stat_text
|where = name="Character" AND id LIKE "%dual%wield%"
|format = ul
}}

Additional bonuses for dual wielding can be obtained from other sources, primarily [[passive skill]]s. Weapons do not have to be of the same type to receive dual wielding bonuses. There are no penalties of any kind to attacks with the player's off-hand weapon. 

The majority of [[attack]] [[skill]]s will alternate between equipped weapons per skill use, swinging first with the main hand and then with the off-hand weapon. The resulting attack time is the average of the two hands' attack times (which is not the same as averaging the attack speeds).<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/1m8ytld/big_misconception_on_dual_wielding_pob_and_wiki/</ref> Some skills (e.g. {{il|Cleave}}, {{il|Dual Strike}}) attack with both weapons simultaneously, in which case the skill directly averages the attack time of the two hands (except {{il|Dual Strike of Ambidexterity}}). Skills that use both weapons simultaneously typically calculate damage per weapon and then [[hit combination|combine their damage]] (except {{il|Viper Strike}}, which hits separately). 

Skills must be compatible with with both equipped weapons to be usable. For example, {{il|Reave}} cannot be used with a dagger and a sceptre. 

When dual-wielding weapons with different range, the range used is dependent on the skill.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3LMcPPPeetM</ref>
* For skills that alternate hands, the hand used uses its respective weapon range.
* {{il|Viper Strike}} alternates weapon ranges.
* {{il|Dual Strike}} always uses the longer weapon range.

It is possible to dual-wield two [[wand]]s; it is not possible to dual-wield a wand and a melee weapon. If a player was able to somehow equip a wand and a melee weapon simultaneously, the wand would be disabled.

[[Unarmed]] attacks normally count as using the main hand, even if the offhand is empty. The skill animations may appear to alternate hands; this is purely visual and does not affect skill calculations. The {{c|mod|Counts as Dual Wielding}} stat found on {{psl|Hollow Palm Technique}} causes unarmed attacks to alternate between hands, however.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/fcflyy/with_the_new_hollow_palm_technique_how_would/fjbbeyy/?context=1</ref>

==Active skills with stats related to dual wielding==
{{Query stat related skill gems
|type=active
|where = skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "%double_hit%"
  OR skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "%dual%wield%"
  OR items.name LIKE "%Ice Crash of Cadence%"
|stat_page=dual wielding
}}

==Items==
===Unique items===
These items contain bonuses which can only be obtained through dual wielding:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables = item_stats
|join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName
|where = 
 (item_stats.id LIKE "%dual_wielding%"
 OR item_stats.id LIKE "%off_hand%")
 AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%off_hand_is_empty%"
 AND items.name NOT IN ( "Seething Fury", "The Squire", "White Wind" )
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1}}

===Mods===
{{modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats, spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where=
 (mod_stats.id LIKE "%dual_wielding%"
 OR mod_stats.id LIKE "%off_hand%")
 AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%off_hand_is_empty%"
 AND spawn_weights.weight >= 0
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|generation_type=1
|domain=1
}}

==Passive skills==
There are [[passive skill]]s that grant dual wielding bonuses.

===Physical damage while dual wielding===
These passive skills grant increased [[damage]] with weapons while dual wielding.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "damage_while_dual_wielding_+%"
}}
===Damage with ailments while dual wielding===
These passive skills grant increased [[ailment]] damage while dual wielding.
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "attack_ailment_damage_+%_while_dual_wielding"
}}
===Accuracy while dual wielding===
These passive skills grant increased [[accuracy]] rating while dual wielding.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "accuracy_rating_while_dual_wielding_+%"
}}
===Attack speed while dual wielding===
These passive skills grant increased [[attack speed]] while dual wielding.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "attack_speed_while_dual_wielding_+%"
}}
===Cast speed while dual wielding===
These passive skills grant increased [[cast speed]] while dual wielding.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "cast_speed_while_dual_wielding_+%"
}}
===Critical strike chance while dual wielding===
These passive skills grant increased [[critical strike chance]] with weapons while dual wielding.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "critical_strike_chance_while_dual_wielding_+%"
}}
===Chance to block while dual wielding===
These passive skills grant additional chance to [[block]] while dual wielding.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id IN ("block_while_dual_wielding_%", "dual_wield_or_shield_block_%")
}}
===Miscellaneous===
Those passive skills do not fit into the categories above:
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
 (passive_skill_stats.id like "%dual_wield%"
 OR passive_skill_stats.id like "%off_hand%")
 AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("damage_while_dual_wielding_+%", "attack_ailment_damage_+%_while_dual_wielding", "accuracy_rating_while_dual_wielding_+%", "attack_speed_while_dual_wielding_+%", "critical_strike_chance_while_dual_wielding_+%", "cast_speed_while_dual_wielding_+%", "block_while_dual_wielding_%", "dual_wield_or_shield_block_%")
}}
===Masteries===
{{Query masteries|where=mastery_effects.stat_text_raw LIKE "%dual%wield%" OR mastery_effects.stat_text_raw LIKE "%off%hand%"}}

===Ascendancy passive skills===
{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id like "%dual_wield%" or passive_skill_stats.id like "%off_hand%"
}}

===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND (items.description LIKE "%dual%wield" OR items.description LIKE "%off%hand%")
|large=1
|description=1
}}

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
* Dual Wielding now inherently grants +20% chance to Block Attack Damage (previously +15%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.16.1|
* Characters that were previously able to equip a Wand and Melee Weapon at the same time have had their Wand disabled.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.11.0|
* No longer grants 20% more physical attack damage. It still grants 10% more attack speed and 15% chance to block attack hits.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.5.0|
* You can no longer use skills that require a specific weapon if you are dual-wielding and one of your equipped weapons is unsuitable for that skill. For example, you will no longer be able to use Reave with a dagger and sceptre equipped.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.3|
* Implicit bonus for dual wielding is now reduced to +10% attack speed. The rest will come from passives.
* Characters now block 15% of the time by default while dual wielding.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.8.6|
* [[Attack speed]] is now calculated correctly while dual wielding.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.6.0|
* Dual wielding works now.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
